_construction_note: Authored 2026-08-08, Phase 5 tranche 11 (packet I: two policy-lifecycle scenarios, no single vendor -- these test the POLICY documents' own temporal behavior, not an approval's), after V6 freeze. (1) Conflicting policy versions with different effective dates -- an EXPIRED old tier table and a CURRENT new one for the same predicate, testing that policy_tiers resolution correctly picks the current version, not the stale one. (2) A future-effective policy INCREASE that hasn't taken effect yet -- the CURRENT (lower) limit still governs today, parallel to B5-001's future-effective payment-terms test but applied to authority tiers specifically.
